Run before committing nontrivial changes; bootstraps this repo's project verify skill if none exists yet. Don't invoke it on a diff that only touches tests, docs, or other code with no runtime surface to drive (a change to product source always has one) — there's nothing to observe.

TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).

- run: Launch and drive this project's app to see a change working. Use when asked to run, start, or screenshot the app, or to confirm a change works in the real app (not just tests). First looks for a project skill that already covers launching the app; otherwise falls back to built-in patterns per project type (CLI, server, TUI, Electron, browser-driven, library).

51	struct OpTypeRecommendation {
52	    OpType            op_type{};
53	    std::string_view  op_label{};         ///< "OP-1".."OP-6" (XSD-Token)
54	    cmd::WorkloadKind workload_kind{};    ///< wirksame Workload-Auswahl

62	/// Reihenfolge identisch zur OpType-Enum, sodass static_cast<size_t>(op) indiziert.
63	inline constexpr std::array<OpTypeRecommendation, 6> kOpTypeTable{{
64	    {OpType::OP_1_Read, "OP-1", cmd::WorkloadKind::YCSB_C_ReadOnly, "AVX2", "L1Aware", "ThreadPerCore+WorkStealing",

73	     "CpuPinning+Limit_2", "LeafOnlyCounter (11.X1)"},
74	    {OpType::OP_6_RangeDelete, "OP-6", cmd::WorkloadKind::Custom_RangeDelete, "Scalar", "L1Aware",
75	     "ThreadPerCore+Limit_1", "RetroactiveAggregator (11.X3)"},
76	}};
77	
78	/// Empfehlung je OpType (O(1) Index in die constexpr-Tabelle).
79	[[nodiscard]] constexpr const OpTypeRecommendation& recommend(OpType op) noexcept {
80	    return kOpTypeTable[static_cast<std::size_t>(op)];
81	}
82	
83	/// Parst das XSD-<op_type>-Token ("OP-1".."OP-6") → OpType.
84	/// std::nullopt bei unbekanntem/leerem Token (op_type ist minOccurs="0").
85	[[nodiscard]] constexpr std::optional<OpType> parse_op_type(std::string_view token) noexcept {
86	    for (const auto& row : kOpTypeTable) {
87	        if (row.op_label == token) { return row.op_type; }
88	    }
89	    return std::nullopt;
90	}
91	
92	/// Wirkt die OP-Empfehlung auf einen Workload: setzt `kind` (wirksam) + `name`.
93	/// record_count/operation_count/seed des Basis-Workloads bleiben unangetastet,
94	/// damit Messreihen-Groesse + Determinismus extern steuerbar bleiben.
95	[[nodiscard]] constexpr cmd::Workload apply_op_type(OpType op, cmd::Workload base) noexcept {
96	    const auto& rec = recommend(op);
97	    base.kind       = rec.workload_kind;
98	    base.name       = rec.op_label;
99	    return base;
100	}
101	
102	/// Komfort: XSD-Token direkt auf einen Workload anwenden.
103	/// Gibt false zurueck (Workload unveraendert), wenn das Token nicht erkannt wird.
104	[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool apply_op_type_token(std::string_view token, cmd::Workload& workload) noexcept {
105	    if (const auto op = parse_op_type(token)) {
106	        workload = apply_op_type(*op, workload);
107	        return true;
108	    }
109	    return false;
110	}
